==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Is the younger brother of [[Minas]] and [[Vigoss]].
* Won [[Lenovo Legion of Champions Series I]] with [[Binh Thanh Gaming]].
* Nicknamed "Demon King Zeros" by fans.
** In the 2019 spring final trash-talk against [[EVOS Esports]], he declared that he would 'cut his head' if his team fail to win 3-0. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yIIKRokBrk PVB vs EVS: Không ăn 3-0 "chặt đầu" Ma Vương!!!] ''youtube. com''</ref> He was nicknamed "The Headless Demon King" after the match.
* Is believed to be in the top 3 best top laners in the world and better than [[Khan]] by his Coach [[Tinikun]] and his fans
** This statement later got heavily memed by VCS' community after [[GAM Esports]] poor performance at [[Worlds 2019]]
* Received a permanent global ban from Riot after making a joke about the COVID-19 pandemic.
